summary.text: Mark Walczyk is a Republican state senator who represents New York State Senate District 49 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

Walczyk, a U.S. Army Reserve veteran and former legislative staffer, served in the State Assembly from 2019 to 2023 and has been a state senator since 2023; he is the Republican and Conservative Party candidate.

paragraphs.text: Mark Walczyk graduated from Paul V. Moore High School, joined the U.S. Army Reserve in 2012, and earned a B.A. in history from the State University of New York at Albany in 2007.

He worked as a legislative staffer in the New York State Senate, including as legislative director and director of Albany operations and as district director for Sen. Patricia Ritchie (R), and served on the Watertown city council from 2016 to 2018.
Walczyk represented Assembly District 116 from 2019 to 2023, succeeding Addie Jenne (D), and has served in the State Senate since 2023, succeeding James Tedisco (R).

In the 2025-2026 session he is ranking member of the Cities 2 Committee and is also assigned to the Energy and Telecommunications; Housing, Construction and Community Development; Internet and Technology; and Banks committees.
In the November 3, 2026 general election, Walczyk faces Cassie Robbins-Forbus (D / Working Families Party).
